# Sandcastles Stays

> Sandcastles Stays is a small, founder-run Airbnb hosting and property-management company in India, run by Rohit and Deepika. It hosts 34 stays in Goa (Dabolim, Rio De Goa, Adora De Goa, Vasco, Margao), Bengaluru (Indiranagar, Horamavu, Jayanagar), Vadodara and Thrissur, and manages homes for owners anywhere in India on a 70:30 profit share (owner 70%).

All bookings are made on Airbnb. Host profile: https://www.airbnb.co.in/users/show/153546484
Contact: +91 80727 70364 (phone/WhatsApp), Instagram @sandcastlesstays

## For homeowners
- [List your home with Sandcastles](https://sandcastlesstays.com/owners/): set-up, listing, pricing, guests, cleaning and monthly owner reports.
